mintAuthority.summary: sDAI is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over DAI; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable DAI mint authority is inherited from reviewed Maker/Sky DAI.

controls.label: sDAI ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095798 (2026-10-01), asset() returned DAI 0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f, name() returned Savings Dai, and decimals() returned 18. EIP-1967 implementation, corrected admin, and beacon slots were zero; owner() reverted. The pinned SavingsDai source has immutable DaiJoin/Pot references, no upgrade entrypoint or privileged share minter, and mints shares against DAI deposited through DaiJoin into Pot.

review.evidence: Refreshed 2026-07-20 from the verified Ethereum wrapper evidence: at block 25294731 sDAI is a non-upgradeable ERC-4626 wrapper (no proxy admin, no owner, and no privileged minter), with asset() = DAI. Shares mint only against deposited DAI, so local wrapper issuance is economically bounded; durable DAI mint authority remains inherited from dai-makerdao. No named prudential supervisor was established for the wrapper itself.
